tokens.name: color-rust-800
tokens.usage: Darkest rust. Text-bearing fill and text colour on light grounds; 6.63:1 on white. Backs semantic-brand-text.

tokens.name: color-rust-700
tokens.usage: The working rust. 4.85:1 on white, so it is the only rust that may carry body-size text or sit under white text. Source of md-primary.

tokens.name: color-rust-600
tokens.usage: THE LOGO ORANGE. 3.21:1 on white and 3.24:1 on navy-900 — it cannot carry text in either direction. Decorative fill only: icons, rules, chart fills, tints, icon-only buttons.

tokens.name: color-rust-400
tokens.usage: Light rust. The accent that works on the navy dark surface (4.67:1). Never on white.

tokens.name: color-rust-100
tokens.usage: Rust tint. Container background behind rust-800 text (5.61:1).

tokens.name: color-sky-700
tokens.usage: Deep sky. Link hover (6.20:1 on white) and semantic-info-text.

tokens.name: color-sky-600
tokens.usage: Link colour. 4.77:1 on white. Reserved for hyperlinks — do not use it as a general accent.

tokens.name: color-sky-500
tokens.usage: Brand sky. Decorative and chart fills, semantic-info borders. Only 2.81:1 on sky-100, so never behind text at that pairing.

tokens.name: color-sky-300
tokens.usage: Light sky. The strongest accent on the navy dark surface (6.04:1).

tokens.name: color-sky-100
tokens.usage: Sky tint. Info container background behind sky-700 text (5.38:1).

tokens.name: color-navy-900
tokens.usage: Brand navy. The secondary role, the app bar, and the de-facto dark surface. White on it is 10.41:1.

tokens.name: color-navy-700
tokens.usage: Lighter navy. The raised variant of the dark surface; white on it is 7.29:1.

tokens.name: color-ink-900
tokens.usage: Near-black ink. All body text and every elevation shadow are mixed from it — never pure #000.

tokens.name: color-charcoal-700
tokens.usage: Dark grey. Secondary text on light grounds where full ink is too heavy (9.89:1 on white).

tokens.name: color-charcoal-500
tokens.usage: Mid grey. The lightest grey that still carries body text on white (5.33:1).

tokens.name: color-charcoal-300
tokens.usage: Light grey. 2.52:1 on white — decorative and disabled states only, never live text.

tokens.name: color-line-300
tokens.usage: Strong hairline. 3.45:1 on white, so this is the grey that may bound an interactive control.

tokens.name: color-line-200
tokens.usage: Default hairline. 1.37:1 on white — dividers and outlined-card edges only.

tokens.name: color-line-100
tokens.usage: Sunken surface. The surface-variant fill behind inset panels and table zebra rows.

tokens.name: color-paper-50
tokens.usage: Page ground. A faintly cool off-white, one step below card white.

tokens.name: color-white
tokens.usage: Card and sheet surfaces, and text on every dark or primary fill.

tokens.name: color-success
tokens.usage: Success green. Borders and icons; pair with semantic-success-text for anything readable.

tokens.name: color-warning
tokens.usage: Warning amber, already darkened to carry text (5.03:1 on the warning container).

tokens.name: color-danger
tokens.usage: Error red. The md-error role; white on it is 5.48:1.

tokens.name: md-primary
tokens.usage: Primary role. Text-bearing buttons, selection, and every state layer. NOT the logo orange — that is md-primary-decorative.

tokens.name: md-primary-variant
tokens.usage: Primary hover and pressed fill.

tokens.name: md-primary-light
tokens.usage: Primary tint for dark grounds and large decorative areas.

tokens.name: md-primary-decorative
tokens.usage: The logo orange. Legal ONLY where no text sits on it, in either direction. Swap to md-primary the moment a label appears.

tokens.name: md-on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill (4.84:1 on rust-700).

tokens.name: md-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary role: app bar, nav rail, footer, and any full-bleed navy band.

tokens.name: md-secondary-variant
tokens.usage: Secondary hover and pressed. The only hard-coded role value in the system — it has no palette entry of its own.

tokens.name: md-on-secondary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a secondary fill (10.41:1).

tokens.name: md-background
tokens.usage: Page background, behind every surface.

tokens.name: md-on-background
tokens.usage: Text directly on the page background.

tokens.name: md-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, menus, dialogs — anything raised off the background.

tokens.name: md-on-surface
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a surface.

tokens.name: md-surface-variant
tokens.usage: Sunken surface: inset panels, table headers, disabled field fills.

tokens.name: md-error
tokens.usage: Error role: invalid field borders, destructive fills, error icons.

tokens.name: md-on-error
tokens.usage: Text on an error fill (5.48:1).

tokens.name: md-outline
tokens.usage: DECORATIVE outline at 1.37:1 — dividers and outlined-card edges. Never bounds a control.

tokens.name: md-outline-strong
tokens.usage: The outline that bounds interactive controls — inputs, selects, outlined buttons. 3.45:1, clearing WCAG 2.2 1.4.11.

tokens.name: md-surface-dark
tokens.usage: The dark surface. Navy, not a neutral black — this system has no neutral dark ground.

tokens.name: md-surface-dark-variant
tokens.usage: The raised step above md-surface-dark.

tokens.name: md-on-surface-dark
tokens.usage: Text and icons on the dark surface.

tokens.name: md-accent-on-dark
tokens.usage: The rust accent for dark grounds (4.67:1 on navy). The logo orange FAILS here at 3.24:1 — use this instead.

tokens.name: md-accent-on-dark-alt
tokens.usage: The sky accent for dark grounds (6.04:1 on navy). The stronger of the two.

tokens.name: md-outline-on-dark
tokens.usage: Decorative divider on the dark surface (1.99:1). Never bounds a control.

tokens.name: md-outline-strong-on-dark
tokens.usage: Control border on the dark surface (4.85:1 on navy).

tokens.name: md-text-high
tokens.usage: High-emphasis text on light grounds: body copy and headings (14.74:1 on white).

tokens.name: md-text-medium
tokens.usage: Medium emphasis: captions, meta, table secondaries ONLY (5.33:1 on white, 5.09:1 on surface-variant). Not for body copy.

tokens.name: md-text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled text (2.58:1). Exempt from contrast minimums because it marks an inactive control — never use it for live text.

tokens.name: md-text-high-dark
tokens.usage: High-emphasis text on the dark surface.

tokens.name: md-text-medium-dark
tokens.usage: Medium emphasis on the dark surface (6.01:1 on navy).

tokens.name: md-text-disabled-dark
tokens.usage: Disabled text on the dark surface (3.90:1). Disabled states only.

tokens.name: md-divider
tokens.usage: Hairline rule between rows and list items on light grounds.

tokens.name: focus-ring-color
tokens.usage: The focus ring. Navy reads against white surfaces at 10.41:1 — but only because the ring sits OUTSIDE the element on the surface behind it. Keep focus-ring-offset at 2px: drawn inset on a rust-700 fill it drops to 2.15:1 and fails.

tokens.name: focus-ring-color-on-dark
tokens.usage: The focus ring on the dark surface.

tokens.name: semantic-success-bg
tokens.usage: Success container fill.

tokens.name: semantic-success-border
tokens.usage: Success container border (4.31:1 on its own fill).

tokens.name: semantic-success-text
tokens.usage: Success container text (6.50:1 on its own fill).

tokens.name: semantic-warning-bg
tokens.usage: Warning container fill.

tokens.name: semantic-warning-border
tokens.usage: Warning container border. 2.60:1 on its own fill — decorative edge only; do not reuse it to bound a control.

tokens.name: semantic-warning-text
tokens.usage: Warning container text (5.03:1 on its own fill).

tokens.name: semantic-danger-bg
tokens.usage: Danger container fill.

tokens.name: semantic-danger-border
tokens.usage: Danger container border (4.47:1 on its own fill).

tokens.name: semantic-danger-text
tokens.usage: Danger container text (6.43:1 on its own fill).

tokens.name: semantic-info-bg
tokens.usage: Info container fill.

tokens.name: semantic-info-border
tokens.usage: Info container border. 2.81:1 on its own fill — decorative edge only.

tokens.name: semantic-info-text
tokens.usage: Info container text (5.38:1 on its own fill).

tokens.name: semantic-brand-bg
tokens.usage: Brand container fill.

tokens.name: semantic-brand-border
tokens.usage: Brand container border. 2.72:1 on its own fill — decorative edge only.

tokens.name: semantic-brand-text
tokens.usage: Brand container text (5.61:1 on its own fill).

tokens.name: md-layer-primary-hover
tokens.usage: Precomputed rust-700 hover layer, for surfaces that cannot stack a translucent overlay.

tokens.name: md-layer-primary-focus
tokens.usage: Precomputed rust-700 focus layer. A wash is not a focus indicator — pair it with the focus-ring geometry.

tokens.name: md-layer-primary-pressed
tokens.usage: Precomputed rust-700 pressed layer.

tokens.name: md-layer-primary-selected
tokens.usage: Precomputed rust-700 selected layer: active nav item, chosen row, selected chip.

tokens.name: md-layer-on-primary
tokens.usage: State layer drawn on top of a primary fill.

tokens.name: md-layer-on-surface
tokens.usage: Neutral state layer on a light surface: row hover, ghost button hover.

tokens.name: md-ripple-light
tokens.usage: Ripple on dark and primary fills.

tokens.name: md-ripple-dark
tokens.usage: Ripple on light surfaces.

tokens.name: link-color
tokens.usage: Hyperlinks, and nothing else. 4.77:1 on white, 4.71:1 on the page ground — but only 4.04:1 on surface-variant, so links in a sunken panel need link-hover instead.

tokens.name: link-hover
tokens.usage: Hyperlink hover (6.20:1 on white). Links stay sky on hover — they never turn rust.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Ships fluid as clamp(2.5rem, 5vw + 1rem, 4rem); 64px is the declared static ceiling for email, PDF and canvas. Weight 400, not M2's 300 — Raleway Light goes thin and washy above 40px.

styles.name: h5
styles.usage: Fixed. Card titles and section heads.

styles.name: h6
styles.usage: Fixed. Dialog titles, dense section heads.

styles.name: subtitle1
styles.usage: Lead-in above body copy; list item primaries.

styles.name: subtitle2
styles.usage: Dense list primaries, table column heads.

styles.name: body1
styles.usage: Default body copy. Tracking is 0, not M2's 0.5px — that default fights Raleway across a full paragraph.

styles.name: body2
styles.usage: Dense body: table cells, cards, secondary copy.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button labels. Set uppercase at the component, not here. No line-height is declared.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Helper text, timestamps, field hints. The floor for any text a user must read. No line-height is declared.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Eyebrow labels above a heading, uppercase. Never for anything longer than three words. No line-height is declared.

spacing.note: Material's 4dp baseline grid. Every gap, pad and inset is one of these steps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, chip inner pad.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacking: label to field, adjacent chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Dense row padding, compact table cells.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: The default. Card padding, list row padding, standard gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between cards, and between a heading and its body.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section padding inside a page container.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page top and bottom padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Between major page bands.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Hero and full-bleed band padding.

tokens.name: grid-baseline
tokens.usage: The unit every other step is a multiple of. Nothing in the system sits off it.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for any control, however small it is drawn.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Maximum content width before the page gutters take over.

radius.note: DELIBERATE: large surfaces are square, controls are softly rounded. shape-large being smaller than shape-small is not a bug — square cards, modals, banners and app bar against 4dp buttons and fields is the intended slightly-industrial read. Do not 'fix' it.

tokens.name: shape-small
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, chips, menus — every control.

tokens.name: shape-medium
tokens.usage: Same 4px as shape-small by design; kept as its own name so a future divergence has somewhere to land.

tokens.name: shape-large
tokens.usage: SQUARE. Cards, modals, banners, sheets, the app bar — every large surface.

tokens.name: shape-pill
tokens.usage: Pills and toggles only, where the shape itself carries the meaning.

tokens.name: shape-circle
tokens.usage: Avatars, FABs, icon-only round buttons, status dots.

shadow.note: Material 2 umbra / penumbra / ambient at each dp level, mixed from ink-900 rather than pure black. Levels 5, 7, 9-11 and so on are deliberately absent — M2 only defines the ones here.

tokens.name: elevation-0
tokens.usage: Flush with its parent: page background, flat list rows.

tokens.name: elevation-1
tokens.usage: Resting cards, the default raised surface.

tokens.name: elevation-2
tokens.usage: Resting contained buttons, raised chips.

tokens.name: elevation-3
tokens.usage: Refresh indicators, small raised affordances.

tokens.name: elevation-4
tokens.usage: App bar at rest.

tokens.name: elevation-6
tokens.usage: Hovered button, FAB at rest, snackbar.

tokens.name: elevation-8
tokens.usage: Menus, open selects, hovered card, bottom nav.

tokens.name: elevation-12
tokens.usage: Pressed FAB, hovered menu.

tokens.name: elevation-16
tokens.usage: Navigation drawer, modal side sheet.

tokens.name: elevation-24
tokens.usage: Dialogs. The ceiling — nothing sits above a dialog.

state.note: Material 2 state-layer opacities. Draw the layer in md-primary over the control for primary surfaces, or md-layer-on-surface for neutral ones. Focus needs its ring as well — a wash alone is not an indicator.

tokens.name: md-state-hover
tokens.usage: Pointer over the control.

tokens.name: md-state-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus, stacked under the focus ring.

tokens.name: md-state-pressed
tokens.usage: Held down.

tokens.name: md-state-selected
tokens.usage: Chosen and staying chosen: active nav item, selected row.

tokens.name: md-state-disabled
tokens.usage: The opacity a disabled control's content drops to.

focus.note: Focus is geometry, not a tint. The ring is drawn outside the control, which is what keeps focus-ring-color legible on a rust fill.

tokens.name: focus-ring-width
tokens.usage: Ring thickness. Text fields are the exception — their 2dp rust-700 active border IS the indicator.

tokens.name: focus-ring-offset
tokens.usage: Gap between control and ring. Do not set this to 0 on a filled control: the ring then lands on the fill and loses its contrast.
